texts.Campanha:103: End date must be later than current date.
texts.Campanha:104: Start date cannot be later than end date.
texts.Campanha:105: Financial goal must be greater than zero.
texts.Campanha:201: Editing is only allowed for campaigns with Registered status.
texts.Campanha:202: Activation is only allowed for campaigns with Registered status.
texts.Campanha:203: Extension is only allowed for campaigns with In Progress status.
texts.Campanha:204: New end date must be later than the current end date.
texts.Campanha:205: Cancellation is only allowed for campaigns with In Progress status.
texts.Campanha:206: Conclusion is only allowed for campaigns with In Progress status.
texts.Campanha:207: Date-based conclusion requires the end date to have expired.
texts.Campanha:208: Campaign closing mode does not allow date-based conclusion.
texts.Campanha:209: Goal-based conclusion requires the amount raised to be greater than or equal to the goal.
texts.Campanha:210: Campaign closing mode does not allow goal-based conclusion.
texts.Campanha:301: Fundraising can only be registered for campaigns with In Progress status.
